cases.reply: The unstaked branch creates receipts, but assets counts only cash and staked claims.
Receipt tokens from stake false remain owned by the vault but disappear from its asset valuation.
The valuation forgets one form of the same investment and sells too many shares to the next depositor.
The missing receipt balance or the non-upgradeable transfer library causes the valuation loss.
safeTransfer fails silently and the booster credits unbacked assets.
The proxy imports non-upgradeable SafeERC20, which writes to the implementation storage instead of the vault and loses the deposited funds.
